name: KAIST Humanoid (v0.7–v0.9)
maker: KAIST Dynamic Robot Control & Design Lab
summary: A full-size biped from Hae-Won Park's lab at KAIST, with motors, drives and controllers designed largely in-house. Version 0.7 (March 2026) showed high-speed running and a moonwalk; v0.9 (October 2026) pushed 35 kg objects and lifted 20 kg using onboard visual feedback.

sources.title: KAIST Humanoid v0.9 Moves 35 kg Objects — Humanoids Daily
